title: Lazar's ominous feeling inside a craft

tellings.quote: It's a real ominous, creepy feeling. And a lot of it is because of the black just it doesn't it doesn't look right.

plain: Being inside a craft he says was not made by humans felt "real ominous, creepy," according to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on such craft for the US government. He tells Michels that much of the feeling came from the blackness inside, which he says "doesn't look right." It is his own first-hand description of what such a machine is like from the inside.
